record.title: Tencent’s Hunyuan-A13B report describes an 80B-total/13B-active model and mixed benchmark comparisons
record.summary: A September 2026 technical report describes Tencent’s Hunyuan-A13B, an 80B-total-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 13B active parameters and a reported 20T-token training corpus. In the authors’ base-model Table 2, Hunyuan-A13B scores higher than Hunyuan-Large on 12 of 14 listed evaluations and higher than Qwen3-A22B on 7 of 12, while Qwen3-A22B leads on others; the report also shows different results across slow- and fast-thinking comparisons. The paper reports 256K context and gives throughput measurements under one listed precision setting, but it does not establish a hardware-matched efficiency advantage over comparable models. These are first-party report claims; benchmark procedures and artifacts were not independently audited.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The authors report an 80B-total/13B-active MoE trained on a 20T-token corpus, and Table 2 reports higher scores than Hunyuan-Large on 12 of 14 benchmarks and than Qwen3-A22B on 7 of 12; rankings vary by benchmark. These first-party scores are not independently reproduced.

evidence_gaps.description: The benchmark scores have not been independently reproduced or audited for contamination and protocol comparability.
The throughput table lacks a hardware-matched comparison against comparable models, so it does not establish a relative efficiency advantage.

brief.importance_rationale: If independently confirmed, a relatively low-active-parameter open MoE with strong scores on selected reasoning and agent benchmarks could broaden feasible deployment options. The model itself was released earlier, and the newly inspected report contains mixed, vendor-run comparisons without hardware-matched throughput evidence, so the consequence is moderate rather than field-shaping.
limitations: The model was released before this technical report; the September 2026 arXiv date is the report event, not the model release date.
Benchmark scores and training details are first-party claims; no independent rerun or contamination audit was performed.
Model rankings are mixed across individual benchmarks and reasoning modes; the paper does not establish a uniform quality advantage.
Reported throughput is not a hardware-matched comparison and cannot by itself establish lower serving cost or energy use.

technical.claimed_result: The authors report that the base model exceeds Hunyuan-Large on 12 of 14 Table 2 evaluations and Qwen3-A22B on 7 of 12, with mixed outcomes across individual benchmarks. Post-trained tables show differing slow- and fast-thinking results. These are author-reported scores, not independent evaluations.
technical.demonstrated_result: No independently demonstrated result is claimed; the source is a first-party technical report.
technical.implementation_status: The report describes an existing open model; no deployment-scale adoption or customer performance is established.
technical.mechanism: The report describes an 80B-total-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts model with 13B active parameters, trained on a claimed 20T-token corpus, with fast- and slow-thinking modes and a reported 256K context. It also describes grouped-query attention and inference optimizations.
technical.regime: Tencent-authored technical report submitted to arXiv in September 2026 about an 80B-total/13B-active model; reported 20T-token training, 256K context, benchmark tables, two reasoning modes and throughput at stated input/output lengths and precision. The report describes a model released earlier; the report date is not the release date.
technical.reproducibility: The report references model and evaluation artifacts. No independent benchmark rerun, contamination audit or hardware-matched throughput reproduction was performed.
technical.strongest_baseline: Table 2 compares base models Hunyuan-Large-1116, Qwen2.5-72B and Qwen3-A22B across 14 named benchmarks. Tables 3–4 compare post-trained models including Qwen3-A22B, DeepSeek R1 and OpenAI o1 in separate fast/slow settings. The paper does not provide a matched independent evaluation or hardware-matched throughput comparison.

brief.title: Tencent’s Hunyuan-A13B report describes an 80B-total/13B-active model and mixed benchmark comparisons
brief.why_it_matters: An open model reporting 13B active parameters with competitive scores against some larger models could matter for deployment choices where access and inference resources constrain use. The report’s mixed per-benchmark rankings and absence of matched throughput comparisons mean the results support only a bounded vendor-reported model profile, not a general efficiency or quality lead.
